name: Barcelona-Catalunya Grand Prix
sources_2026_10_03: Formula1.com race report and results (2026-06-14), FIA race report and final classification (2026-06-14), Mercedes race report (2026-06-14), Audi race report (2026-06-14), Williams race report (2026-06-14), Pit Debrief (2026-06-14).
summary: Lewis Hamilton won by 19.561s for his first Ferrari victory, using a three-stop strategy and a well-timed VSC after Fernando Alonso stopped at Turn 9. George Russell led early but settled for second, while Lando Norris completed the first all-British podium since 1968. Kimi Antonelli passed Russell for P2 with about four laps left, then suffered an electrical shutdown; Charles Leclerc also retired late with power-steering failure. Seven official retirements included Stroll, Bottas, Hulkenberg, Alonso, Bearman, Antonelli and Leclerc, while Albon returned 11 laps down; Colapinto's 10-second yellow-flag penalty dropped him from P8 to P10.
